name: conventions
description: Powercademy's living conventions for Power Platform delivery — Dataverse schema judgement (statecode over custom status, solution and publisher discipline, dependency packaging), the Power Automate and PCF lessons that cost hours once (editing live flows, child-flow contracts, whether PCF is the right tool, the premium-licensing trap), applied before and alongside any build, plus the writing-skills house standard for authoring skills that work in both runtimes. Each rule carries its reasoning; the lists grow with every corrected mistake.
